import pandas as pd


def run(inputs: dict[str, "pd.DataFrame"]) -> dict[str, "pd.DataFrame"]:
    txns = inputs["transactions"].copy()

    # Preserve original columns, sort per legacy cursor ORDER BY
    txns = txns.sort_values(
        by=["account_id", "txn_date", "txn_seq"],
        kind="mergesort"  # stable sort to mimic deterministic cursor order
    ).reset_index(drop=True)

    # Compute amount treating NULL as 0 for running sum, but keep original amount in output
    amt_filled = txns["amount"].fillna(0)

    # running balance resets per account_id
    running_balance = amt_filled.groupby(txns["account_id"]).cumsum()

    out = pd.DataFrame({
        "account_id": txns["account_id"],
        "txn_seq": txns["txn_seq"],
        "txn_date": txns["txn_date"],
        "amount": txns["amount"],
        "running_balance": running_balance,
        "overdraft_flag": (running_balance < 0).astype("int64")
    })

    out = out.reset_index(drop=True)

    return {"acct_balance_flags": out}
